item.title: Going to Ariana Grande’s Eternal Sunshine Tour? Dress the Part With These Urban Outfitters Pieces
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey music lovers, welcome to our podcast. If you're a fan of Ariana Grande, you're in luck because her Eternal Sunshine Tour is underway, with nearly 30 stops scheduled across the United States. And, of course, no concert is complete without some merchandise. Urban Outfitters has just dropped a line of exclusive Ariana Grande tees, and we're excited to share them with you."
[Music transitions to a softer beat]
Host: "These limited-edition tees are priced at $40 each and feature artwork from different eras of Grande's career, from her debut album 'Yours Truly' to her latest 'Eternal Sunshine'. What's great about these tees is that they're affordable, considering most concert merch can cost over $100. And, once they're sold out, they're gone for good, so you'll want to act fast."
[Music transitions to a clip of Ariana Grande's song]
Host: "We've picked out a few of our favorites from the collection, including a graphic t-shirt dress and a baby tee. The t-shirt dress features artwork from Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' era and has a slouchy, off-the-shoulder neckline. It's a comfortable option that you can wear to one of her concerts with combat boots or bloomers."
[Music transitions back to the softer beat]
Host: "Another standout is the 'Yours Truly' graphic baby tee, which references Grande's debut studio album. This tee is form-fitted and sleek, making it a great option for those who want something a little different from the usual baggy graphic tees. You can style it with high-waisted jeans or shorts for a chic look."
[Music transitions to an outro]
Host: "So, if you're attending one of Ariana Grande's concerts or just want to show off your fandom, be sure to check out Urban Outfitters' exclusive line of tees. They're only $40 each and won't be around for long. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode."
[Outro music plays]
